title: fix: preserve generation coordinator migration
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Retains the already-applied Durable Object v2 migration after the feature rollback
- Keeps an inert coordinator export and binding without routing generation traffic through it
- Prevents Wrangler from replaying the PollenRateLimiter v1 migration

gist.headline: Migration memory restored
gist.blurb: The hive kept its migration map after a feature rollback. No traffic rerouted, no old Durable Object history accidentally replanted.
gist.summary: Preserved the applied Durable Object v2 migration by retaining an inert GenerationCoordinator export and binding, preventing Wrangler from replaying the PollenRateLimiter v1 migration.
gist.impact: Generation traffic continues using its existing route while future deployments retain the correct Durable Object migration history.
gist.visual_concept: Polli is a careful gardener preserving labeled seed packets in a cozy server garden: one packet is marked GenerationCoordinator and an older PollenRateLimiter packet stays safely archived, representing migration history being retained without activating the coordinator. A small CRT monitor robot can inspect the garden ledger while vines and code-plants signal safe deployment continuity.
